name: High Minus Low
description: HML factor spread: the return of high book-to-market equities minus low book-to-market equities. Bundled evidence is synthetic; the metric definitions describe its return basis.
positive_direction: A positive factor return means the high book-to-market side outperformed the low book-to-market side.

name: Robust Minus Weak
description: RMW factor spread: the return of firms with robust operating profitability minus firms with weak operating profitability. Bundled evidence is synthetic; the metric definitions describe its return basis.
positive_direction: A positive factor return means the robust profitability side outperformed the weak profitability side.

name: Momentum
description: MOM factor spread: the return of recent outperformers minus recent underperformers. Bundled evidence is synthetic; the metric definitions describe its return basis.
positive_direction: A positive factor return means recent winners outperformed recent losers.
